description: Added opt-in dashboard REPL access for PostgreSQL, Redis, Valkey, MongoDB, MySQL, and SQL Server. Selecting the REPL command on a running resource opens the bundled client (psql, redis-cli, valkey-cli, mongosh, mysql, or sqlcmd) in the dashboard terminal dock, already authenticated to the container, so developers can query local resources without installing clients or copying credentials.
name: Docked REPL commands for database and cache integrations
